name: Set Up Perimeter Floor Protection (Roll)
intent: Install drop cloths or floor runner along the perimeter of the room only. Used for roll application where overspray is not a concern and only paint drips/splatter at the wall base need protection. Faster install than full cover.
doctrine: Perimeter protection covers a strip ~3 ft wide along all walls. Quantity (PS_PROTECT_SF.FLOOR_PERIMETER) is derived from room perimeter LF × 3 ft. Setup rate is faster than full cover (600 vs 400 SF/hr) because the strip pattern is simpler than full plastic with seams.
